_note: The baths a farmer gets into up to the shoulders (2026-11-22, Baths step 2; docs/DESIGN.md → ที่อาบน้ำ); `changing` the sento's changing room's lines (its own note). Per bath id (a soak prop's `bath`, e.g. the tub `yubune` in data/maps/sento_bath.json) the same keys as the footbath's data/ashiyu.json (Game.soak with this as its soak_cfg: `sit_path` [t, seat (cells toward the tub), lift (units up in 3D), pose], `seat`, `lift`, sit_seconds, stand_seconds, step_until, the messages), and: `turn` the facing the farmer turns to once sat, from `turn_at` (t) on (in the tub they sit facing the room, the eye); `day` which daily rest it counts toward: "bath" (Game.bathed_today: the sento and the rotenburo share one a day) or "foot" (the footbath's own); `minutes` the game minutes the day's first bath takes (the clock runs at its own pace while sat, even indoors, and the rest passes on getting out: Game.soak_owed); `villager_in` / `villager_out` the game minutes a villager's {"bathe": minutes} step takes to get in and out along sit_path (Villagers.bath_place; the farmer's sit_seconds / stand_seconds at 0.5 s a minute, about). The pose "bathe" (FigureArt._bathe): the head and bare shoulders over the water with a folded towel on the head; the picture's bottom row is the water's surface, so `lift` is the water's height (BathProps.WATER). Everyone bathes in a wrap in this valley (one bath for all, the user's pick): nothing below the shoulders is drawn. Balance numbers are ours: the sento's 120 G buys +40 stamina and -20 fatigue for an hour (the footbath +20 / -15 free and quick, a night's sleep from 22:00 about -42): worth an evening, never a stand-in for bed.

together._note: The spouse's bath night (data/villagers/<spouse>.json married_bath, sunny Tuesdays and Saturdays): talking to them at home 16:00-19:00 asks the farmer along (talk_<spouse>.json wed_bath_invite); "Let's go together" sets the flag bath_together and Game.go_bath_together has them walk with the farmer (Companion): `gap` cells behind along the farmer's own path through every door (within `gap` they stand and face the farmer; a loop of the path coming back within `loop_cut` cells of them is cut); once the farmer goes into the changing room they change too (`change` minutes), get into the bath at the first free of `seats` (cells along the tub's front row) and stay in as long as the farmer: when the farmer gets out (or leaves the room, or at `close`, just before the bath shuts) they get out too, saying wed_bath_out, dress (`change`), come out of the lobby's noren behind the farmer and walk home with them, saying wed_bath_home inside the farmhouse door, where they stay. Past `give_up` still on the way there, or down the mine, they go home on their own. They pay the day's ticket (bath_paid_today); `paid` names them (%s). Ours: 1.2 cells is a step and a half behind, close enough to read as together, clear of the farmer's heels.
together.paid: %s comes along with you, and will pay Masa for the two of you.

changing._note: The sento's changing room (data/maps/sento_changing.json, the basket shelf's "use": "change"; Game.change_clothes): into a bathing towel and back, the bath's door only for the farmer in a towel (`need_towel`), the lobby's only dressed (`dress_first`).
changing.to_towel: You fold your clothes into a basket and wrap a towel round yourself.
changing.to_clothes: You dry off and put your clothes back on.
changing.need_towel: Change into a towel at the baskets first.
changing.dress_first: Get dressed at the baskets before going back out.
changing.hands: Put down what you're holding first.

sento.message: You sink into the hot water up to your shoulders. An hour slips by, and the day's aches with it.
sento.again_message: You sink into the water again. Pleasant, but the day's rest is already had.
sento.hands_message: Put down what you're holding first.
sento.seat_message: Step down into the tub from the tiles in front of it.
sento.taken_message: Someone is already soaking there. Find a free spot along the tub.

kajika._note: Kajika-yu, the rock pool of hot spring water up the river's gorge (data/maps/kajika.json, 2026-11-24, Baths step 4; docs/DESIGN.md → ที่อาบน้ำ): the sento's keys, and `hours` (open from the first until the second, a minute of the same game day: past midnight counts on, DayPlan.minute_of; Game.bath_open, `closed_message` outside them), `towel` (only in a towel, changed into at the hut beside it: `towel_message`), `stamina_full` (the day's first soak fills stamina to the max). The pool is sunk in the ground with the map's water (BathProps.ONSEN_WATER, -0.34): one steps down off its shore into it, from any open cell beside its water (the prop's seats "shore"). Ours: free and far, so the most rest of the three (DESIGN: stamina full, fatigue -30, 1.5 h of the clock), still not a night's sleep (about -42 from 22:00). It shares the day's bath with the sento (`day`). `wade`: sat in it the move keys move the bather about in the deep water at that share of walking speed (the user: half), never onto the sloping bank or into a rock (Game.wade_by, wade_ok); E gets them out at the nearest edge in reach, else `edge_message` (Game.stop_soak). `bed`: the pool's full depth below the land (SunkenGround.DROP): the bather is never drawn below the ground under them (Game.soak_lift: the soft shore's bank slopes down over about the first half of the water cell, so stepping in they walk down it, the path's lift only a floor, and sink into the bathing pose only at the seat, over the deep bed (2026-11-26, the user: getting in they still sank into the ground beside the pool: the old path sat them down at -0.34 while still over the bank)). Every `ring_every` cells waded a ring spreads on the water round them and the `wade` slosh plays (Game.waded; the user wanted the water to move round them).
kajika.message: You lower yourself into the spring among the rocks. The river runs below, and an hour and a half drifts away with the steam.
kajika.again_message: You slip into the spring again. Lovely, but the day's rest is already had.
kajika.hands_message: Put down what you're holding first.
kajika.seat_message: Step down into the pool from its edge.
kajika.taken_message: Someone is already soaking there. Find a free spot along the pool.
kajika.towel_message: Change into a towel at the hut first.
kajika.closed_message: The pool is being flushed with river water. It's ready again from 16:00.
kajika.edge_message: Wade over to the edge to get out.
